example.title: Vermillion County Bridge No. 120, Main Street over the Little Vermilion River

brief: Two-span reinforced-concrete filled-spandrel arch carrying a small town's Main Street out over the river, 1913, 208 ft long and only 20.8 ft wide out to out with a single 18.7 ft lane. Two flat segmental arches on a central pier with a rounded cutwater, solid spandrel walls, and a paneled solid concrete parapet; tall square concrete standards (lamp-post pedestals) stand at the end posts. Guardrail was added at both ends in 1980. Woodland and a few houses at the town edge, a gravel side road meeting the approach.

traits.railing_detail: solid paneled concrete parapet with tall end standards

names.plate: MAIN STREET BRIDGE · 1913 · COUNTY COMMISSIONERS · MARSH & NOLAN, CONTRACTORS
